svg.title: CPFriendFinder — Sequence — Friend Call and Screen Sharing

g.text: CPFriendFinder — Sequence — Friend Call and Screen Sharing
Subscribe room signaling BEFORE sending ACCEPT
Handle offer collision / validate signaling state
Add or replace media track; negotiate if required
Attach remote media / choose focused tile
Media travels browser-to-browser or through TURN, not the Node HTTP tunnel.
Screen choices depend on browser/OS; capture requires user permission.
Multi-participant rooms repeat peer negotiation per participant.
